name: newsh2-171
summary: Spinning brown pod (newsh2 frames 171-266): an armoured brown teardrop, blunt and widest across its top rows and drawn out to a point at the bottom, flattened to about half as thick as it is wide (9 px face on, 5 px edge on). It spins about its long axis over the six frames, each frame its own model turned to match. Shape language: hard-surface armour, a faceted shell with crisp longitudinal edges (shoulder facets either side of a raised central spine, a sharp keel along each side), a groove cut round the shoulder, and a small glossy lens set in the spine.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: teardrop outline: widest (9 px) across rows 2-4, tapering to a 1 px point at row 13
thick: about 5 px top to bottom at the shoulder (half its width), thinning toward the point
hard-surface armour shell with flat facets and crisp edges, not a smooth egg
brown mid-tone, the lower point darker (rows 9-13)
features.note: The baseline lofted a smooth 14-sided egg; the concept reads the pod as riveted armour plates.

traits: a raised, flat-topped bevelled strip down the centre (column 6), rows 3-12, on both faces
light tan over rows 3-6, fading to the body colour toward the point
bridges over the shoulder groove (row 3 is light on column 6)
features.note: The concept's central armoured spine. The baseline had a round tube with knob ends from row 3.6 to 9.4.

traits: small elongated near-white lens on the spine at row 5 (column 6), on both faces
glossy glass set in the spine, slightly raised, faint glow
features.note: The sprite's single 31 pixel; the concept draws a glowing yellow lens in the spine. The baseline had a round stud ball.

traits: a dark band right round the shoulder at row 3
cut into the shell (stepped walls), not a raised painted ring
features.note: The baseline built it as a dark ring slightly proud of the body.

traits: light crests at columns 3-4 and 8 in rows 1-4, dark seams at columns 5 and 7 beside the spine
built as flat shoulder facets with crisp edges either side of the spine, not painted stripes
features.note: The concept's rounded armour pads at the top corners.

traits: a crisp keel edge along both sides of the pod, rows 1-12
a thin light rib on it, flush with the outline, that shows as the bright centre line on the edge-on frame (228)
features.note: The baseline had round tubes standing off the edges like wires.

traits: faceted like the body, ends in a sharp tip
features.note: The concept wraps it in V-shaped plates.
